Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Draft ACHPR study, mandated by Resolution 473, analysing how AI, robotics and emerging technologies affect rights under the African Charter, including civil, socio-economic, peoples' and group rights. It reviews African, international and national law and African values, and recommends governance measures for states, corporations and institutions.
annotation.title_clean: Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence, robotics, and other new and emerging technologies in Africa
annotation.title_en: Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence, robotics, and other new and emerging technologies in Africa
key_provisions_or_claims: Responds to ACHPR Resolution 473 (2021) mandating a study on AI, robotics and human rights
Assesses AI opportunities and risks for each African Charter right, including life, dignity, non-discrimination, vote and work
Examines state, individual and corporate obligations in AI governance
Finds existing law inadequate and stresses African ethics and values in governance
Recommends actions for states, developers, institutions and research bodies, including human rights education and transparency
annotation.venue: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
